tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Specialist | Java, Spring, PWA Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and headless PWA integrations. Proven track record designing data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM, optimizing performance, and supporting production at scale. Skilled in agile, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, and AI-assisted development, bridging business requirements with technical delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Akamai Specialist – SAL1 Looking for your next opportunity in ... (SFCC & PWA)
cover_en.hook: I am excited to join Innova ESI to help shape cutting-edge edge delivery solutions. With more than five years of building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs and PWA headless integrations that align with your focus on advanced CDN configurations.

bullets.label: **API Integration**
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and exposed OCC REST web services and built robust data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM, ensuring seamless API integration across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: **Performance & Scalability**
bullets.text: I led database query refactoring and optimized FlexibleSearch queries at Shell, reducing latency and supporting high-traffic storefronts, a foundation for reliable edge performance.

bullets.label: **CI/CD & Cloud Delivery**
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) using Docker and Kubernetes, delivering rapid, automated releases that complement CDN rollout pipelines.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Consulting**
bullets.text: I worked directly with international business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional specifications and user stories, bridging the gap between business goals and technical implementation.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: INNOVA ESI’s reputation for pioneering edge and CDN technologies, especially around Akamai, aligns with my passion for delivering high-performance, headless e-commerce experiences. I am eager to apply my proven SAP Commerce Cloud integration and PWA expertise to help your clients accelerate content delivery, improve latency and innovate at the network edge. Joining a forward-thinking team that shapes the future of digital commerce excites me.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to bring my SAP Commerce Cloud and PWA integration expertise to INNOVA ESI, helping build next-gen edge solutions that enhance performance and customer experience.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering Java-Spring APIs and PWA integrations for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m keen to discuss the Akamai Specialist role at INNOVA ESI.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Akamai Specialist – SAL1 (SFCC & PWA)
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Akamai Specialist – SAL1 position. With over five years of experience building SAP Commerce Cloud platforms, designing REST/OCC APIs, and implementing PWA headless solutions for global enterprises, I am confident I can add value to INNOVA ESI’s edge initiatives. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
